intent: Check whether a Moldex Pro Classic 9B0-CGL respiratory protection variant (mask type disposable respirator, protection class basic, size one size) exists in the catalogue.
success_criteria: SQL returns the product_variants row(s) matching brand Moldex, model 9B0-CGL and all three properties (mask_type=disposable respirator, protection_class=basic, size=one size), or returns zero rows
Answer contains a <YES> or <NO> token reflecting catalogue presence
If a row matches, its exact record_path is cited in refs

args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.product_name, pv.brand, pv.series, pv.model FROM product_variants pv WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.model = :model AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'mask_type' AND p.property_value_text = :mask_type) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'protection_class' AND p.property_value_text = :protection_class) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND p.property_key = 'size' AND p.property_value_text = :size);

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

answer_template.message: <YES> The respiratory protection variant Moldex Pro Classic 9B0-CGL (mask type disposable respirator, protection class basic, size one size) is in the catalogue: {match.product_sku} at {match.record_path}. / If no row: <NO> No such variant exists in the catalogue.
